source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: When the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase) ends, an empty Ynnari Venom can take aboard one eligible unit of up to 6 models. Choose a friendly unit with both **YNNARI** and **INFANTRY**. The entire unit must be within 6″ of the Venom. The unit can board from enemy [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) even on a turn when it already left this Venom.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
